title: Scrollspy
description: A contents list that watches the page: the section you are reading is the one it lights.
usage: For long pages with a table of contents — docs, guides, policies. The observer marks the section near the top of the viewport; clicking still uses plain anchors, so the back button and deep links keep working. In an app, the scroll container is whatever actually scrolls.
a11y: The links are plain anchors to real ids, and the current one carries aria-current="location" — the highlight is the same information for every reader, not a color alone.
